name: crypto-analyst
install: curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh && export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH" && uv sync --extra web --extra dev && mkdir -p .cache/data && { [ -f .env ] || cp .env.example .env; } && uv run analyst db init

terminals.name: web
terminals.command: export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH" && uv run analyst web --no-open --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000
